# GEEKFUN

> SqlKit and DocKit are open-source (Apache 2.0) desktop database clients from GEEKFUN for macOS, Windows, and Linux. SqlKit connects to 68+ SQL databases including PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, SQLite, DuckDB, and ClickHouse. DocKit covers NoSQL engines including MongoDB, DynamoDB, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, and EasySearch. Data Studio Agent is an open-source MCP server (`npx -y @geek-fun/data-studio-mcp`) that lets AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, and OpenCode query databases through local DocKit and SqlKit connections.

## Key facts

- **License**: Apache 2.0 open source for SqlKit, DocKit, and Data Studio Agent.
- **Pricing**: Community edition is free forever with unlimited connections, query editing, schema browsing, and CSV/JSON export. GEEKFUN Data Studio Ultimate (USD 9.90/month or USD 99.00/year, with a 7-day free trial) covers all three tools and adds Agentic Data Studio (BYO LLM: OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Ollama, LM Studio), MCP Bridge, ER diagrams, bulk data transfer, and cluster management. Versions released during a paid subscription remain usable after cancellation.
- **Architecture & privacy**: Native desktop apps built with Rust and Tauri. Connection credentials stay in the OS keychain and are never sent to LLMs; MCP binds locally (`127.0.0.1`) with per-connection read/write permissions and approval gates for destructive actions.
- **Platforms**: macOS (Apple Silicon & Intel), Windows, and Linux.
